impl_requirements: Emit a single .cu translation unit exposing a PYBIND11_MODULE with a forward() binding that launches the kernel; no host-side framework calls beyond the binding. Compilation via mxcc (mxgpu_llvm from MACA SDK).
read_metric_guide: High dram_pct with low sm_pct => memory_bound. High sm_pct with low dram_pct => compute_bound. Low occupancy with neither saturated => latency_occupancy (occupancy is always null on MetaX; this class is declared but requires additional launch-config analysis). Many short kernels / launch-dominated wall time => overhead_bound.

vectorized_load_store.idiom: float4 / int4 vectorized global loads and stores
vectorized_load_store.prompt_guidance: Widen memory transactions to 128-bit by casting to float4/int4 so each thread moves 16 bytes per access. mxcc targets the MetaX SIMT ISA with 128-bit memory path.

memory_coalescing.prompt_guidance: Reorder the thread-to-element mapping so consecutive threads in a warp read consecutive addresses, issuing a single 128-byte transaction per warp.

shared_memory_tiling.prompt_guidance: Stage global data in __shared__ memory, double-buffer for overlapped copy+compute, and sync with __syncthreads() between load/compute phases. MetaX shared memory is partitioned per-SM; keep tile size within per-SM limits (~48–64 KB typical).

tensor_core_mma.idiom: N/A on MetaX (no dedicated tensor cores); approximate via vectorized warp-level intrinsics
tensor_core_mma.prompt_guidance: MetaX GPUs lack dedicated tensor-core units. Use warp-level vector intrinsics or hand-unrolled SIMT code to approximate high-throughput matrix multiply. mxcc may auto-vectorise if loops are structured for it.

async_copy_pipeline.idiom: Manual double-buffered async copy via __shared__ staging with warp-shuffle
async_copy_pipeline.prompt_guidance: Pipeline global-to-shared copies with warp-level shuffles. Overlap the copy for tile N+1 with the compute for tile N using two __shared__ buffers and __syncthreads().

register_blocking.prompt_guidance: Decompose the computation into register-sized blocks, keeping intermediate values in registers across iterations to reduce shared memory traffic.

launch_config_tuning.idiom: Occupancy-tuned block/grid dimensions via mxcc auto-tuning flags
launch_config_tuning.prompt_guidance: Choose block size to maximise occupancy on MetaX hardware. Prefer 256–512 threads/block; use mxcc -march=<target> to target the specific MetaX GPU ISA for optimal register allocation. Sweep block sizes empirically.
